$comment: Licensed under CC-BY-4.0. A device with its identifiers: the old profile's hardware, renamed. A record of any more specific device type (wifi-access-point, openwrt-device) also names this type, so that a device-account can link to a device without listing every device type.
title: Device

warranty_until.description: The day the manufacturer's warranty ends. A warranty ending does not make the device invalid, so this is not valid_until.

valid_until.description: The day the record stops being valid. Empty means it does not expire.
